title: nemophila sepulta var. minutiflora
intro: Nemophila sepulta var. minutiflora, commonly known as the Baby Blue Eyes or Annual Nemophila, is a species of flowering plant in the borage family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Nemophila sepulta var. minutiflora include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to relieve anxiety and muscle tension.
